biography: Benjamin Beverage combined local government, state formation and historical writing. Vinalhaven’s office roster lists him as a selectman in thirteen years between 1806 and 1822. Maine’s constitutional record names him as Vinalhaven’s delegate to the 1819 convention, and the Maine Historical Society preserves his December 20, 1819 manuscript account of Vinalhaven settlement, land distribution, vessels and religion. He later represented Vinalhaven and surrounding islands in the Maine House in 1823.
evidence_status: Verified/strongly supported — official state records, surviving manuscript and town roster
